translations.web: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.
translations.bsb: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one receives the prize? Run in such a way as to take the prize.
translations.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
translations.asv: Know ye not that they that run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? Even so run; that ye may attain.
